main_text.head: DE SECVNDA PARTE, QVÆ est Tractatio principalis seu essentialis huius libri.
main_text.l: Propositionem argumenti bipartitam, in ea quæ sunt
Enarrationem partium quæ est eorum quæ sunt
præsentia, enarratio didascalica secundum septem Ecclesias. ca .2.&3.
Communis de mundo universi[?] eius partes duæ
Malorum quæ mundo eventura sunt divinæ prænunciationes, & præsignificationes: c.6.
Electorum vindicatorū ab omni malo obsignatio divina, ante prænunciatorum malorum complementum: c. 7.
Singularis de Ecclesia Christi: vide infra ad cap. 10. & sequentia.

page.notes: Right edge shows part of the neighbouring page, not transcribed. Faint mirrored text in the lower half of the page (show-through from the reverse) is left out. Readings marked [?] in the diagram are uncertain: the abbreviations "onā" and "vocā-" and the word after "Communis de mundo" are hard to make out at this resolution. The diagram boxes were read as an outline; the exact depth of the lower boxes under "Præparatoria" and "Ipsa opera" is inferred from the brace lines.
